title: Preserve work descriptions on posted sales prepayment documents
summary: Work descriptions are now loaded and preserved on posted sales prepayment invoices and credit memos, matching the behavior of standard sales posting when invoice discount calculation is enabled.
key_points: Work Description BLOB is loaded immediately before TransferFields in prepayment header creation to prevent data loss after discount redistribution
Fixes issue where prepayment posting reloads the sales header after recalculating discounts, requiring the BLOB to be reloaded
Four regression tests added covering prepayment invoices and credit memos with automatic invoice discount calculation enabled and disabled
Changes propagated through Miapp localization mechanism to nine posting codeunits and three test codeunits across multiple regions
